LandingPage.title: LandingPage
LandingPage.description: Defines an e-commerce high-converting landing page generated and customized by the user.

userId.description: The firebase auth user ID of the owner of this page

productName.description: The name of the custom product

niche.description: The niche template structure e.g. luxury, beauty, tech, streetwear, minimal, educational, fitness

pageData.description: The detailed structured JSON page data containing features, benefits, faq, hero, guarantee, config, etc.

image.description: Base64 or URL profile image representing the product

isPublished.description: Whether the landing page is publicly accessible/published

landingPages/{pageId}.description: Store user custom generated and tailored-made landing pages and funnels.
